_doc: Facility upgrades (ROADMAP §3.10): menu purchases that expand what you can CREATE, never what you can grind (Law 2 — every conquest reward must expand creation). A track is an ordered list of levels; you buy them in order, each gated by money and usually by territory. `grants` is read by the systems that care: the Surgery Theater reads frames and sockets, so unlocking the Rumbler chassis and the second organ bay is a data edit, not an engine one. Levels beyond the last are simply absent — adding Tier III means appending an object here. Other tracks named in §3.10 (Gene Scanner, Extractor efficiency, Infirmary speed, Containment Cannon mk2) drop into the same shape.

levels.name: Tier I — Card Table & Optimism
levels.blurb: A folding table, a desk lamp, and a signed waiver you wrote yourself.

levels.name: Tier II — The Rumbler Rig
levels.blurb: A gantry, a winch, and a second organ bay. Unlocks the L-class Rumbler chassis and lets you install TWO organs — metabolism, or a second ability, or both if you can carry the mass.
levels.unlockLine: Surgery Theater upgraded to Tier II. The gantry arrived on a flatbed and the neighbours have stopped asking.
levels.news: Farm supply store reports a run on industrial winches. "Big year for barns," says owner, unconvincingly.
